articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 28, 2025-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS, the “Company” or “Tillys”) today announced that effective August 18, 2025 , Nate Smith has been appointed to the position of President and Chief Executive Officer and as a Director of the Company.
articles.title: Tilly's, Inc. Announces Appointment of Nate Smith as President and Chief Executive Officer Beginning August 18, 2025.
